What this exercise can show
×

Arrows follow an OSM practice path, not an approved evacuation route. Buildings with unknown heights use labelled 3 m massing. The coarse DEM and chosen water surface have no verified common vertical datum here; their difference is not a flood depth or safety margin.

Separate research context: in the unreviewed Khao Lak preprint, the PD50 walking-preference package changes modeled victim share from 21.8% to 7.0% among 39,041 synthetic agents under baseline timing (§4.3). This browser exercise does not compute those outcomes. SSRN 7270357 ↗

Stay away from the coast until local officials permit return. The first wave may not be the largest.
